reviews.title: Very unique and excellent motherboard
reviews.comment: I love this motherboard. The fact that everything is on the back is so cool. I had to buy a case that would allow me to use it which was an additional expense but it was worth it. Make sure you go to https://pangoly.com/ and check the compatibility with cases before you buy this motherboard.
reviews.author: doc42418
